{{Recipe summary
| Category = Soup recipes
| Difficulty = 1
}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
* [[Cookbook:stock|Stock]]
* 2 bunches of [[Cookbook:sorrel|sorrel]], washed and cut up
* 1 bunch of [[Cookbook:endive|endive]], washed and cut up
* 1 head of [[Cookbook:lettuce|lettuce]], washed and cut up
* 1 small bunch of [[Cookbook:chervil|chervil]], washed and cut up
* 1 stick of [[Cookbook:celery|celery]],washed and cut up
* 1 [[Cookbook:carrot|carrot]], washed and cut up
* 1 [[Cookbook:onion|onion]], peeled and cut up
* Sliced French bread, toasted
* [[Cookbook:Cheese|Parmesan cheese]], grated

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] everything except for the bread and cheese in the stock for an hour.
#Put some slices of toasted French roll into a bowl, and pour the soup over them.
#Serve with grated Parmesan.
